No interiors; no private projected imagery is packaged. A 0.35m ownership tolerance around the surveyed building resolves the narrow OSM/BVV outline mismatch; northern equipment beyond that band remains protected. Fine stone/plaster collision uses horizontal sixteenth-metre profiles and full vertical Minecraft cells.
